title: MSSQL MCP Server
blurb: MCP tooling that gives AI coding assistants database schema context on demand.
description: Built an internal MCP server connecting Cursor and Claude Code to MSSQL schema context, reducing manual copy-pasting.

caseStudy.heading: Problem
caseStudy.body: AI coding assistants needed database context while engineers worked on application code. Passing schema details manually interrupted the development workflow.

caseStudy.heading: Implementation
caseStudy.body: Built an MCP server that exposes MSSQL schema context to coding assistants, with TypeScript and Node.js connecting the tools to the database.

caseStudy.heading: Use in the workflow
caseStudy.body: Integrated the server with Cursor and Claude Code so engineers could request schema context as part of their existing coding workflow.

caseStudy.heading: Engineering focus
caseStudy.body: Making context available through a tool interface helps reduce manual context switching. This overview describes the approach without exposing company source code or database details.

resumeDescription: Internal MCP server exposing MSSQL schema context to Cursor and Claude Code.

title: AI Assistant Platform
blurb: An AI assistant with multi-LLM support, Python execution in Docker, chat summarization, and connectors.
description: Built an AI assistant with Docker-based Python execution, chat summarization, deferred connectors, and multi-LLM support.

caseStudy.heading: Problem
caseStudy.body: An AI assistant needs more than a chat interface: it must manage conversation context, use tools, execute code, and connect to external services.

caseStudy.heading: Implementation
caseStudy.body: Built the interface and supporting services with Angular and .NET. Added Python code execution in Docker containers, chat summarization for longer conversations, deferred connector handling, and multi-LLM support.

caseStudy.heading: Related AI engineering
caseStudy.body: Company copilot work included a unified streaming API across Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude; embeddings and hybrid retrieval for tool discovery; and Google Workspace/Microsoft 365 MCP connectors with OAuth/PKCE and per-user token isolation.

caseStudy.heading: Reliability and security
caseStudy.body: Investigated tool-call and empty-output failures, compared models, and reviewed generated outputs. Worked on prompt-injection hardening and context handling.

resumeDescription: AI assistant with Docker/Python execution, chat summarization, connectors, and multi-LLM support.

title: yogeshcrafts.in
blurb: A Next.js portfolio on Cloudflare Workers with OpenNext and a shared resume content pipeline.
description: Next.js portfolio on Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext, with shared web/PDF resume content, themes, and dynamic share cards.

caseStudy.heading: Goal
caseStudy.body: Present software engineering and applied AI work in one place, with a readable web resume and a downloadable PDF.

caseStudy.heading: Implementation
caseStudy.body: Built the site with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, responsive layouts, and dark/light themes. The deployment uses OpenNext on Cloudflare Workers.

caseStudy.heading: Resume content
caseStudy.body: Curated public JSON supplies the portfolio and web resume. A Node.js generator creates the LaTeX resume from the same approved content, and the resume workflow compiles the PDF.

caseStudy.heading: Presentation
caseStudy.body: Added dynamic Open Graph images, a sitemap, readable technology labels, explicit project ownership, and case-study links.

resumeDescription: Personal Next.js portfolio on Cloudflare Workers with a shared web/PDF resume pipeline.
